《解放军军报》发表评论文章，《新时代最可爱的人》以浪漫主义笔法描绘了战士们出国前的最后一个春节，展现了新时代年轻战士乐观浪漫、热爱生活又敢于牺牲的大无畏精神。
各大军区报纸转载《新时代最可爱的人》，号召战士们向前线战士学习。
凌晨五点，刘济民在四三零高地的指挥部内监视着下面的高地。山间寂静得可怕，远处的山脊线纵横交错。
刘济民刚坐下休息一会儿，就有人跑来报告前方发现一队人，约莫大半个连，穿着我军的军服，左手臂扎着白毛巾，还唱着红歌，说是增援部队。
“没听说要增援啊，有点不对劲，去，把坑道内的战士都喊起来。”刘济民让人把几个手电筒打开放在工事上，人从其它地方对他们进行观察。
“怎么回事儿，济民？”
“说是增援的，不对劲。这天还没亮，唱什么歌儿啊，好像恨不得告诉所有人，他们是咱们的人。不远处还有敌人活动，这么大张旗鼓，不怕被发现？”
“你说的有道理。”
“关键是胳膊上的毛巾，这明显在做区分！”
“是越南人？”宋大根立即让人子弹上膛。
马贵生怕弄错，刘济民笑道：“喊一句投降，再朝天放一枪，自己人肯定不会动手。”
马贵生让战士们做好准备，如果对方有异常，立即开枪。
“狗日的投降吧！”
马贵生喊完，还没等开枪，对方就开始往上冲了。
阵地上，轻重火力朝着下面一阵招呼，信号枪向山下发射了小型照明弹，照着位置一顿乱揍。周边部队反应过来后，正准备支援，猴子见势不对，扔下十几具尸体就跑了。
大晚上的，没有追击，但是重机枪和迫击炮一直追着打。等凌晨下山的时候，抓到了一个俘虏，还是个中尉。对方腿上中弹了，没能跑掉。
这个中尉兴许是为了在夜晚被自家士兵区分，战斗一开始，就脱了伪装，换了越军的衣服。
“松开！松开！”
“你懂中文？”

"The People's Liberation Army Daily" published a commentary article, "The Loveliest Person in the New Era" depicts the last Spring Festival of the soldiers before going abroad in a romantic style, showing the optimism, romance, love of life and fearless spirit of the young soldiers in the new era.
Newspapers from major military regions reprinted "The Loveliest Person in the New Era" and called on soldiers to learn from frontline soldiers.
At five o'clock in the morning, Liu Jimin was monitoring the high ground below in the headquarters of Highland 430. The mountains were eerily silent, criss-crossed by ridgelines in the distance.
Liu Jimin had just sat down to rest for a while when someone came to report that a group of people, about half of the company, were seen in the front, wearing our army's military uniforms, with white towels tied on their left arms, and singing red songs, saying they were reinforcements.
"I didn't hear about reinforcements. Something is wrong. Go and call out all the soldiers in the tunnel." Liu Jimin asked people to turn on several flashlights and put them on the fortifications, and people observed them from other places.
"What's going on, Jimin?"
"It's not right to say they are reinforcements. It's still dark. What kind of song are you singing? It seems that you want to tell everyone that they are our people. There are enemy activities not far away. Are you not afraid of being discovered with such a big fanfare?"
"You have a point."
"The key is the towel on the arm, it's obviously making a difference!"
"Are they Vietnamese?" Song Dagen immediately asked someone to load the bullet.
Ma Guisheng was afraid of making a mistake, so Liu Jimin laughed and said: "Shout surrender and then fire a shot into the sky. Our people will definitely not take action."
Ma Guisheng asked the soldiers to be ready to shoot immediately if there was any abnormality on the other side.
"Surrender like a dog!"
After Ma Guisheng finished shouting, before he could shoot, the opponent started to charge upward.
On the position, light and heavy firepower greeted the people below, and the signal gun fired small flares down the mountain, beating them randomly according to the position. After the surrounding troops reacted, they were preparing to provide support. Seeing that the situation was wrong, the monkey abandoned a dozen corpses and ran away.
There was no pursuit at night, but heavy machine guns and mortars kept chasing us. When we came down the mountain in the early morning, we captured a prisoner, a lieutenant. The opponent was shot in the leg and could not run away.
Perhaps in order to be distinguished by his own soldiers at night, the lieutenant took off his disguise and changed into the clothes of the Vietnamese army as soon as the battle began.
"Let go! Let go!"
"Do you understand Chinese?"
